applyTo: "src/ragdesk/**/models.py,src/ragdesk/**/service.py,migrations/**/*.py"

> Verified: 2026-11-23 · Source: [standards](https://github.com/clipvoz/standards) and the official docs of each tool.

# SQLAlchemy 2, pgvector and Alembic

- MUST use `Mapped`, `mapped_column` and `select()`. MUST NOT use the legacy `Query` API.
- Relationships MUST use `lazy="raise"`; load them explicitly (`selectinload` for collections,
  `joinedload` for many-to-one).
- MUST index every column used to filter a list, starting with the tenant key (`bot_id`, `owner_id`).
- MUST prefer database constraints (unique, FK, CHECK) over code-only checks.
  Use `ON DELETE CASCADE` for owned rows.
- Embeddings: `Vector(768)` columns with an HNSW index (`vector_cosine_ops`). Query with
  `embedding.cosine_distance(q)` and set `hnsw.iterative_scan = relaxed_order` for filtered searches.
- Full-text: a generated `tsvector` column with a GIN index. Query with
  `websearch_to_tsquery('simple', :q)`.
- One Alembic migration per model change. MUST read and correct the autogenerated file before
  committing. `alembic check` MUST report no drift in CI. NEVER edit an applied migration; add another.
- MUST test against real PostgreSQL with the pgvector extension (testcontainers), never SQLite.
